title: work_order
description: Shape of the fenced ```yaml work_order block a prompt-writer-compiled Agent/Task prompt must open with. Validated by work-order-gate.sh (via lib/work-order-compile.py) before a spawn is allowed. Semantic intent (what to do) is the model's job; this schema only enforces syntax — defaults, execution policy, path safety, and acceptance are supplied by the gate, never by the order itself.

schema_version.description: Bumped only on a breaking shape change, so the gate can reject or migrate a stale order instead of silently misreading it.

intent.description: One sentence: the outcome the order exists to produce.

workspace.description: The worker claims its worktree through atask (atask claim), so the spawn needs no harness worktree: the harness isolation guard would refuse the worker's only completion path, atask verify complete.

allowed_writes.description: Glob patterns of paths the worker may modify. Enforced against the worker's actual git diff by work-order-verify.sh, not merely declared.

required_inputs.description: Files the worker must read to understand the task. Optional: not every order has extra reading beyond the primary targets.

given.description: Facts, decisions, and finished artifacts (with paths) already established before this order. The worker reuses them and never re-derives, re-captures, or re-verifies them.
